in_marathi.name: Rajnath
in_marathi.long_meaning: Rajnath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Rajnath is derived from two Sanskrit words - 'Raj' meaning king and 'Nath' meaning master or ruler. Thus, Rajnath means 'King's Rule' or 'Rule of a King'.
